description: Use when writing browser tests for sign-in redirects, protected-route bounces or destination-preservation in a repository whose production-parity test image seeds every visitor with an auth token for Lighthouse and Playwright runs. Symptoms include an end-to-end spec that can never reach the logged-out state, a protected route that never redirects under test, and acceptance criteria wording that assumes an unauthenticated first visit.
